description: Ex Fuerza Aérea del Perú Mirage 5P, taken on FAA charge in 1982 and upgraded to Mara standard; installed 2012 beside the 1983 Francisco Pelló statue of a pilot pointing to the islands, blown off its mount in a storm 10 March 2013, restored and re-erected. Photographed 16 January 2023 in period scheme with its original serial.
museum_name: Monumento al Piloto de Malvinas Mirage Mara, Río Gallegos
